original_test_intent: Verify the BF3 board is safely removable/reinstallable in its designated slot, mechanically retained and fully seated, and returns with correct host PCIe, DPU management and network functions without new errors.
original_method: Capture BF3 FRU/serial/firmware, slot/riser, cables and host/DPU baselines; quiesce, shut down, remove AC and discharge; qualified ESD operator detaches and reinstalls the board using vendor latch/retention sequence; inspect contacts/slot/bracket/cables; boot and compare PCIe width/rate, DPU services/interfaces, network links and error/log state; restore configuration.
manual_activity: Qualified operator removes/reinstalls the exact BF3 board; agent may collect host/DPU/link evidence.
required_inputs: BF3 FRU/serial/firmware, slot/riser and cable topology
Expected PCIe, DPU service/interface, network link and error state
safety_requirements: Quiesce workload, remove AC and verify discharge
Use ESD and qualified handling; protect adjacent cables/components
Stop on damage, wrong slot, excessive force or failed retention
Do not power before inspection or repeat reseat blindly
agent_execution_scope: Collect pre/post host PCIe, DPU, network and logs
Do not handle hardware, approve live service, infer seating from one plane, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve board/slot/cable map and service procedure
Approve seating/retention criteria and cycle count
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Software only validates post-service behavior and cannot replace board removal or retention inspection.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Compare BF3 FRU/PCIe topology, DPU services/interfaces and network link/errors around the manual cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Board plug cycle, seating and error-free redetection remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use de-energized documented service plus traceable physical evidence and host/DPU/network validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds topology, electrical isolation, retention and BF3 multi-plane oracles.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Host PCIe presence can coexist with failed DPU management, representor or network functions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reseating can disturb high-speed contacts, auxiliary cables and interface naming; rollback requires another controlled shutdown.

project_override_considerations: If BF3 carries separate power, management or thermal assemblies, include their removal/reconnection and verification in the approved service plan.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently requests BF3 board plug cycling, seating and error-free redetection.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Valid manual work once board-specific procedure/operator/recovery are available.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2271 Wistron-HW-00027-V003: approve BF3 board FRU/serial/firmware, PCIe slot/riser and power/management/network cable map; vendor shutdown/AC removal/discharge, latch/retention/torque and reinstall procedure, cycle count and objective contact/slot/bracket seating criteria; define expected PCIe width/rate, DPU services/interfaces, network links, error/log baseline, rollback and final configuration.

review_improvement: Preserves physical BF3 board coverage while requiring full host and DPU functional recovery instead of generic detection.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BF3 is both a PCIe endpoint and a DPU with independent management and data-plane state. Marginal seating can reduce PCIe capability, and a board may enumerate while DPU services or links remain unavailable. Thus the mechanical cycle must be de-energized, tied to exact FRU/slot/cabling, and followed by distinct host, DPU and network checks plus physical retention evidence.
